evidence: trg_enforce_queue_token_customer_update (BEFORE UPDATE) lets the token holder set only status='LEFT' and payment_status='PENDING_CONFIRM', and blocks business_id/customer_user_id changes (QUEUE_STATUS_NOT_YOURS_TO_SET / PAYMENT_STATUS_NOT_YOURS_TO_SET / IMMUTABLE_FIELD). Verified on staging with role authenticated (scratchpad/test_80.mjs probes).

MyQueues keeps the user-scoped realtime filter (other customers' rows are not readable) and polls refetch() every 15s while any token is WAITING/CALLED, so a position change caused by someone ahead still lands. E2E critical/queue asserts customer2's 'You're #2 · 1 ahead' becomes 'No one ahead of you' after the owner calls customer1.
isQueuePayable(status) = CALLED or SERVED (src/lib/queueMath.ts); BusinessDetail payableQueue also requires paymentStatus UNPAID. A WAITING or EXPIRED token shows no quick-pay banner.

MyQueues history = !isActiveEntry(q) || dismissedIds.has(q.tokenId), so a dismissed served-unpaid card moves to History (with Pay now still available) instead of disappearing from both tabs; the Dismiss link hides once dismissed.
parsePartySize clamps to MAX_QUEUE_PARTY_SIZE (8) and to >= 1; used by myQueues, QueueManager ETAs and walk-in creation.

QueuePaymentSheet.claim() refuses an empty or zero amount ('Enter the amount you paid') before calling claimQueuePayment; the input already strips anything but digits and '.'. E2E critical/queue-console asserts the toast, then pays ₹120.
The X on a queue card opens a confirm sheet ('Yes, leave queue' / 'Yes, cancel'); E2E critical/queue leaveIfQueued drives it.
useQueryWithRealtime holds refetch in refetchRef, so the channel effect doesn't resubscribe per render (same fix as MY_APPOINTMENTS:A8; the per-screen loop was E2E-013 in ChatThread).

A called card now shows Directions (Google Maps walking route from the customer's location) and Message shop (chatService.getOrCreate with the business subject) — myQueues selects businesses.lat/lng/owner_user_id for it.

grep '#fff' in QueuePaymentSheet.tsx, PaymentMethodPanel.tsx, MyQueues.tsx and BusinessDetail.tsx: none (2026-09-16). Surfaces use var(--surface); text on a coloured fill and the QR backing use var(--white).

Turning the queue off with anyone still in line opens a confirm sheet naming the count ('N customers still in line will be removed and notified'), because expire_tokens_on_queue_close expires WAITING/CALLED tokens without an arrival or payment in progress. E2E critical/queue-console: Keep queue open leaves it ON; Close queue and remove 1 closes it and the customer's history shows 'Queue closed by shop'.

callNextToken updates only a row that is still WAITING and retries with the next customer when it matches nothing (up to 5), returning who was really called; callSpecificToken throws 'Someone else already called or served this customer.' instead of reporting a call that never happened. QueueManager toasts the returned name and refetches when it differs from its optimistic pick.

Remove (no-show) calls removeNoShowToken → closed_reason 'NO_SHOW'. Migration 20260980: on_queue_token_update notifies the owner 'left before paying' only when the customer themselves left (auth.uid() = customer_user_id), and notifies the customer 'Removed from the queue' when the shop removed them. Console history badges it 'No-show', the customer's history reads 'Missed your turn'. Forced-rollback test + E2E critical/queue-console (asserts the owner gets no 'left before paying' row).
Each waiting row has 'Call this customer' (callSpecificToken) alongside 'Mark served', and the board has 'Call next — <name>'.
QueueManager subscribes to queue_settings changes for this business (channel queue_settings_<id>) and refetches, so another terminal's open/close or avg-time change lands.

Called rows have a Message <customer> button (useMessageUser → chatService.getOrCreate, E2E-041) for tokens with an account; walk-ins have none. Customer phone numbers stay private by design — chat is the contact channel.

Request payment goes through request_payment_nudge() (20260980), which refuses a second reminder within 10 minutes (6 hours for agreements) with NUDGE_COOLDOWN and refuses an already-paid visit. E2E critical/queue-console asserts the second tap shows 'A payment reminder was already sent in the last 10 minutes.'
The walk-in party input is max={MAX_QUEUE_PARTY_SIZE} and the value goes through parsePartySize, which clamps to 8.
grep '#fff' in QueueManager.tsx: none (2026-09-16) — the three literals are var(--white) on coloured fills.
